releaseNotes: Matches the To Me offline experience on iPhone and iPad: first installation and repairs run in the background after the app opens, with a small progress chip instead of a blocking full-screen setup screen.
Uses the To Me verified package engine: resumable downloads, per-file byte-size and SHA-256 checks, staged updates, and one safe restart after the verified package is committed.
Keeps the existing iOS cache namespace shbace-medical-offline-v2 and IndexedDB identity so saved app files and student data are retained.
Aligns the iOS Service Worker with To Me local-first delivery and bounded network fallback while preserving the iOS home-screen icon and onboarding screens.
Keeps the seven-day automatic update schedule and the manual Check for updates action in Settings.
